name: Poels 2025 elranatamab QSP scenarios
description: Source-anchor exact checks and nominal public-ODE dynamic runs for the Poels 2025 elranatamab QSP model.

scenarios.name: Exact public source anchor
scenarios.description: Zero-duration run that exposes public SI model counts, parameters, initial ranges, and study-design constants as exact derived outputs.

scenarios.name: MM-3 12/32/76 mg with Q2W switch nominal ODE
scenarios.description: Nominal 12/32/76 mg SC input with a fixed Q2W switch at week 24 through week 39. This is only an initial segment of the source response-adapted regimen; it omits the subsequent Q4W switch and has no patient-specific response gate.

scenarios.name: 76 mg QW nominal dose-response mechanism
scenarios.description: Nominal weekly 76 mg public-ODE run aligned with the dose-response simulations in main Fig. 4.

scenarios.name: 152 mg QW nominal high-dose mechanism
scenarios.description: Nominal weekly 152 mg public-ODE run to inspect the high-dose side of the published dose-response exploration.

scenarios.name: 16 mg QW nominal dose exploration
scenarios.description: Nominal 16 mg QW SC dose input from the paper's Figure 3 regimen comparison. The fitted virtual populations, patient-specific priming histories and BRR output are unavailable; this is not Figure 3 reproduction.

scenarios.name: 28 mg QW nominal dose exploration
scenarios.description: Nominal 28 mg QW SC dose input from the paper's Figure 3 regimen comparison. The fitted virtual populations, patient-specific priming histories and BRR output are unavailable; this is not Figure 3 reproduction.

scenarios.name: MM-1 44 then 76 mg QW nominal input
scenarios.description: Nominal 52-week dose input for MagnetisMM-1 Part 2A, Supplementary Table 4. No patient-specific virtual-population states, response-conditioned switches, clinical observations or population efficacy outputs are reproduced.

scenarios.name: MM-1 44 then 76 mg Q2W nominal input
scenarios.description: Nominal 52-week dose input for MagnetisMM-1 external Q2W arm, Figure 6d and Supplementary Table 4. No patient-specific virtual-population states, response-conditioned switches, clinical observations or population efficacy outputs are reproduced.

scenarios.name: MM-3 12/32 then 76 mg QW nominal input
scenarios.description: Nominal 52-week dose input for MagnetisMM-3 Cohort A, main Methods and Supplementary Table 4. No patient-specific virtual-population states, response-conditioned switches, clinical observations or population efficacy outputs are reproduced.
